Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL2157854. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate; return all qualifying activity rows.
